summary: postinstall fetches and executes binary from bare-IP host with TLS verification disabled
details: The package's postinstall lifecycle script downloads a platform tarball from the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz/, extracts a binary, chmods it 0o755, and hardlinks it into bin/.onecode so subsequent invocations of the `onecode` CLI execute it. The https.get call is made with `rejectUnauthorized: false`, disabling TLS certificate verification, and no hash or signature check is performed on the fetched bytes. Delivery of executable code over an unauthenticated, unverified channel from a bare IPv4 address on a non-standard port means the operator of that IP — or any on-path attacker — controls the code that runs on every installer's host at `npm install` time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
